title: Regret this purchase
text: Regret this purchase. Was really excited to get these towels.  When I got them they smelled very strong of chlorine and they weren't as soft as advertised.  They almost felt like they have been already used in the past maybe at a hotel.  They also absorbed water VERY poorly.  I am extremely disappointed.  Now I have to pay $12 to ship them back.
